name: com.filadepuentes/mcp
title: Fila de Puentes
description: Live US-Mexico border wait times: 32 CBP ports, best crossing, history, cameras, border news.

tools.name: get_wait_times
tools.description: Current US–Mexico border crossing wait times (minutes) per bridge or port: the number filadepuentes.com publishes (CBP, adjusted by fresh community reports; in el-paso also cameras and manual verification). A crossing whose data_status is not 'live' (estimate, cbp_frozen, unverified, stale, no_data, no_vehicle_lanes) has standard_min null on purpose: quote data_note, never a number. Use for 'how long is the line right now'. Returns standard (car; Ready Lane is part of it), SENTRI and pedestrian waits, lanes open, and a source_url. Lerdo is SENTRI-only (sentri_only true): its number is SENTRI, never a car wait. Cities: el-paso, tijuana, mexicali, nogales, agua-prieta, laredo, piedras-negras, acuna, reynosa, matamoros, progreso. Default el-paso (the six Juárez–El Paso bridges).

tools.name: best_crossing
tools.description: Which bridge or port in a city has the shortest car line right now. Ranks open crossings by their published live standard-lane wait (estimates, frozen and stale readings are left out). In el-paso, best is chosen among the in-town bridges (Puente Libre, Zaragoza, Santa Fe; Libre wins a tie); Tornillo and Santa Teresa are listed apart in out_of_town, and SENTRI-only Lerdo is never ranked. Use for 'which bridge is fastest' / 'por dónde cruzo'. Cities: el-paso, tijuana, mexicali, nogales, agua-prieta, laredo, piedras-negras, acuna, reynosa, matamoros, progreso.

tools.name: best_time_to_cross
tools.description: Historical pattern, not live data: average and peak waits, best and worst day of the week, best hour, per bridge. Use for 'when is the line shortest', 'best time to cross', 'best day', 'cuándo hay menos fila'. Every city: el-paso uses the site's published number; the other cities use CBP's car-lane history. Hours are local time at the crossing. These are ordinary-week averages: for a holiday (Thanksgiving / Black Friday, Christmas, New Year, Semana Santa, paisano season) also call border_knowledge, because those days run far above them.

bridge_slug.description: Optional, one crossing. el-paso: santa-fe, puente-libre, lerdo, zaragoza, tornillo, santa-teresa. Elsewhere a slug from get_wait_times (e.g. tijuana-san-ysidro, nogales-mariposa). Omit for the whole city.

days.description: Days of history to analyze. el-paso: 1–90, default 90 (matches filadepuentes.com/mejor-hora). Other cities: 1–30, default 30. Holidays are always excluded.

tools.name: wait_history
tools.description: Hourly standard (car) lane averages for one Juárez–El Paso bridge, newest hour first. Use for 'is it getting better or worse'. Slugs: santa-fe, puente-libre, lerdo, zaragoza, tornillo, santa-teresa.

tools.name: border_news
tools.description: Latest border news stories from filadepuentes.com/noticias, aggregated from ~48 Mexican and US outlets and summarized in Spanish. Use for 'what is happening at the border / at the bridges today'. Optional city filter. Each story has a url.

city.description: Optional crossing city to filter by.

tools.name: answer_wait_question
tools.description: Turn a natural-language question like '¿cuánta fila hay en Santa Fe?' or 'how long is the San Ysidro line?' into a ready-to-post answer with live numbers (CBP data plus community reports, on every crossing) and a link. Detects the city and bridge from the question. Returns {reply, data, source_url}. Reply language follows the question (Spanish or English) unless `language` is set.

tools.name: border_knowledge
tools.description: Curated, source-cited answers about crossing the US–Mexico border: SENTRI and Ready Lane rules and costs, documents, what you can bring, bridge hours and quirks, tips per crossing. This is filadepuentes.com's own knowledge base (the one its assistant Fili uses), not a web search. Returns the best-matching passages with titles and relevance scores. Use for any how-to or 'can I / do I need' question. Ask in Spanish or English.

tools.name: bridge_cameras
tools.description: Live camera views of the crossings, so the person can see the line themselves: for 'is there a camera at Puente Libre', 'show me the San Ysidro line', 'cámaras del puente'. Returns each camera's latest still frame (image_url, a JPEG refreshed every ~15 min; captured_at says when), what it shows, and page_url, the filadepuentes.com page with the live video. Cameras: el-paso (Santa Fe, Puente Libre, Zaragoza, Lerdo, Tornillo), tijuana, mexicali, laredo, nogales, piedras-negras, matamoros, reynosa. Never tell the person a crossing has no camera without calling this.

bridge_slug.description: Optional, el-paso only: santa-fe, puente-libre, lerdo, zaragoza, tornillo, santa-teresa.

tools.name: watch_bridge
tools.description: For 'tell me when Santa Fe drops under 30' / 'avísame cuando baje la fila'. This server cannot message the person later on its own (no agent keeps a connection open for hours), so this returns the crossing's live wait now, whether it is already under the number, and signup_url: filadepuentes.com's free email alert for that crossing, which the person opens and finishes (email + days). Alerts start at under 20 minutes (San Ysidro 45, Otay Mesa 30); the person can set their own number afterwards from the link in their alert emails. Nothing is subscribed by calling this tool. Cities: el-paso, tijuana, mexicali, nogales, agua-prieta, laredo, piedras-negras, acuna, reynosa, matamoros, progreso. In el-paso, bridge_slug is one of santa-fe, puente-libre, lerdo, zaragoza, tornillo, santa-teresa; elsewhere use a slug from get_wait_times (or omit it for the city's alerts).

bridge_slug.description: The crossing to watch (a slug from get_wait_times).

below_minutes.description: Alert when the car wait drops under this many minutes, 5–180. Default 20.
